sentences.text: JITENDRA S/O SHRI GOVIND MALVIYA, AGED ABOUT  23 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
LABOUR CASTE S.T. R/O  VILAGE DUPADIYA, POLICE STATION PARVATI,

DISTRICT SEHORE (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VIJAY SHUKLA, ADVOCATE)
 AND

1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION PARVATI DISTRICT SEHORE  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. VICTIM A D/O NOT KNOWN THROUGH POLICE  STATION PARVATI DISTT. SEHORE (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI S. K. RAI, GOVT. ADVOCATE &
 SHRI RAJESH KUMSR NEMA, ADVOCATE FOR OBJECTOR)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant who is in jail since 12.3.2024 in connection with Crime No.113/2024, registered at Police Station Parvati, District Sehore (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 323, 342 and 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix came to the house of applicant.
Family members of prosecutrix were informed.
They came to the house and took away prosecutrix.
Later on report of rape has been lodged.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State as well as learned counsel for the objector opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has gone to answer the call of nature.
From their applicant has forcibly kidnapped the prosecutrix and took her to his house where she has been raped.
Case is not of consent.
Prosecutrix is minor.
In these circumstances applicant may not be enlarged on bail.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. On going through a spot map it is found that place from where kidnapping is said to have been done is populated place and having houses all over the area.
Incident is of night.
If anybody raises voice, same could have been heard by nearby residents of the area.
Nobody heard about the incident even in house of prosecutrix.
From statement under section 164 CrPC, it is clear that brother of applicant Vinod has called the relatives of prosecutrix and informed them regarding presence of prosecutrix in the house.
They came to the house of applicant and took away prosecutrix.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial on aforesaid conditions.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Jitendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177211321/
